Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the time of day when a shadow is shortest. A shadow is shortest when the sun is at its highest point in the sky (solar noon), which typically occurs around 12:00 PM (noon) or shortly after depending on Daylight Saving Time. The Planner's reasoning that the shadow is shortest "2–3 hours after solar noon due to thermal inertia" is scientifically false; thermal inertia affects air temperature, not the geometric length of a shadow caused by the sun's angle. Consequently, the Planner concluded the answer was 4:05 PM (Option C) instead of the correct 12:05 PM (Option B).
